1.method: G0 through G3 deposited model/support/brim trajectories, not printer start/end routines. Exact angular extrema of each G2/G3 arc plus start/end radius mismatch; conservative deposited envelope adds line width / 2 and 0.003 mm rounding allowance. Per-command bounding-box separation from exclusion rectangle.

support_region_checks.method: CAD-derived axial/section probes tested against conservative projected extrusion-command bounds and matching Z layers. Bore cylinders and socket rectangular envelopes conservatively enlarged at Z ends by 0.28 mm. Runner-gap section probes trim 0.7 mm at each CAD surface and use 0.2 mm orthogonal tolerance and 0.28 mm in Z. This section sampling is not a global boundary check.

12.52.method: Sample actual XY deposition centerlines at ≤0.035 mm intervals and subtract both extrusion radii. Compare the first free-edge overhang wall with supporting toolpaths from below, including the nominal 0.28 mm air gap after accounting for model layer thickness. Positive sample edge-to-edge gap means no overlapping extrusion footprint for that point. Compare sample neighborhoods, not entire upper blade or physical output.
